snippet.title: MOTHER: Encore Act 2 Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
On with the show!

We'd like to announce that MOTHER: Encore will be getting a major update in the form of Act 2, releasing Spring of 2026!

Ninten's journey continues as he sets out to the mysterious land of Magicant, where he'll see new sights, meet new foes, and learn what bein' friends is all about.

This is a content update for the game containing Magicant and Merrysville, and not a full release.

https://motherencore.com/
